causes.hypothesis: Paid social traffic broke in September: spend and clicks held steady but landing_404s exploded and sessions collapsed, so paid_social orders fell from ~196 to 28, cutting total sales independent of the price change.

Q22.purpose: Source‑specific conversion rate difference between August and September to determine if the drop is broad or limited to paid_social
Q22.sql:
SELECT
  t.source,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-08' THEN t.order_id END) AS orders_aug,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-08' THEN CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE) END) AS sessions_aug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-09' THEN t.order_id END) AS orders_sep,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-09' THEN CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE) END) AS sessions_sep,
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-09' THEN t.order_id END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-09' THEN CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE) END), 0)) -
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-08' THEN t.order_id END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.month = '2026-08' THEN CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE) END), 0)) AS conversion_diff
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.date, wt.source, wt.sessions,
         date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
    ON to_date(o.date) = to_date(wt.date)
   AND o.channel = wt.source
  WHERE to_date(o.date) >= to_date('2026-08-01') AND to_date(o.date) < to_date('2026-10-01')
    AND wt.source IN ('organic','email','paid_social','referral')
) t
GROUP BY t.source
ORDER BY t.source;

  wt.source,

  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN wt.sessions END) AS sessions_aug,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END) AS orders_sep,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN wt.sessions END) AS sessions_sep,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END) / SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN wt.sessions END)) -
   (SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END) / SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN wt.sessions END)) AS conversion_diff
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.date, wt.sessions,
         date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
    ON o.date = wt.date
   AND o.channel = wt.source
  WHERE o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01'
    AND wt.source IN ('organic','email','paid_social','referral')
) t
GROUP BY wt.source
ORDER BY wt.source;

Q26.purpose: Average order value and conversion rate by source and month to examine price influence
Q26.sql:
SELECT
  wt.source,
  date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
  AVG(CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_price_usd,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(wt.sessions) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(wt.sessions) AS conversion_rate
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
  ON o.date = wt.date
 AND o.channel = wt.source
WHERE o.date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.date < '2026-10-01'
  AND wt.source IN ('organic','email','paid_social','referral')
GROUP BY wt.source, month
ORDER BY wt.source, month;
